Name: Custom Warp Points
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
This mod lets you easily change the tile destination for any existing warp connecting any two maps. 

This mod does not let you create new warp points - it just lets you change destinations for existing warp points.

Custom warp points can be either specified in the config.json file or using Content Patcher.


[size=5][b]Syntax[/b][/size]

The syntax for warp points is

[b]"<WarpPointToChange>": "<NewX>,<NewY>"[/b]


There are three possible ways of specifying a warp point to change:

[list]
[*][b]<OriginMapName>,<DestinationMapName>[/b]
[*][b]<OriginMapName>,<DestinationMapName>,<VanillaX>,<VanillaY>[/b]
[*][b]<DestinationMapName>,<VanillaX>,<VanillaY>[/b]
[/list]
[b]VanillaX [/b]and [b]VanillaY [/b]refer to the original destination tile point. This is useful if there are two destination points connecting the same two maps.

So, for example, to change the warp point from the farm to the farm cave from 8,11 to 8,10 , you could use one of the following:

[code]"Farm,FarmCave":"8,10"
"Farm,FarmCave,8,11":"8,10"
"FarmCave,8,11":"8,10"
[/code]

[size=5][b]Usage[/b][/size]

[size=3][b]config.json[/b][/size]

Edit this mod's config.json file (created after running the game with it installed). Example:

[code]﻿{
  "EnableMod": true,
  "AdditionalWarpDictFilePath": "CustomWarpPoints",
  "WarpDict": { "Farm,FarmCave,8,11":"8,10" }
}
[/code]

[size=3][b]Content Patcher[/b][/size]

You can create a Content Patcher mod that adds custom warp points by referencing the file path specified in [b]AdditionalWarpDictFilePath[/b].E.g.:

[code]﻿{
   "Format": "1.23.0",
   "Changes": [
      {
         "Action": "EditData",
         "Target": "CustomWarpPoints",
         "Entries": {
            "Farm,FarmCave,8,11":"8,10"
         }
      }
   ]
}
[/code]


[size=5][b]Technical[/b][/size]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url], doesn't use Harmony.

Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6338]Mod Updater[/url]﻿ for automatic updates.
